meta.name: apex-stats
meta.description: Spawn-count analytics for the tonone roster — which agents this project actually uses, from local session transcripts. Use when "which agents do we actually use", "show tonone stats", "prune the roster", or before running apex-profile.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析项目实际使用的 agent 及使用频率
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想了解项目中哪些 agent 被实际使用来优化名单
copy.tagline_en: Analyze which agents your project actually uses and how often
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to know which agents are actually used in your project to prune the roster

howto.what: 安装后，该技能会统计本地会话记录中每个 tonone agent 被调用的次数，生成报告展示最常用的 agent、通用 vs tonone 的比例以及从未使用的 agent 列表，并给出精简建议。
howto.when: 当用户询问“我们实际用了哪些 agent”、“显示 tonone 统计”或“精简名单”时触发；也可在运行 apex-profile 前自动执行。

say.text: 显示 tonone 统计报告
say.note: 技能将统计本地会话并输出报告。

say.text: 我们实际用了哪些 agent？
say.note: 技能列出最常用的 tonone agent。

howto.what_en: After installation, this skill tallies spawn counts of tonone agents from local session transcripts, producing a report of top agents, generic vs tonone split, and unused agents, with pruning suggestions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when user asks "which agents do we actually use", "show tonone stats", or "prune the roster", or before running apex-profile.

say_en.note: Skill will tally local sessions and output report.

say_en.text: Which agents do we actually use?
